Winged Shadow Carry.name: Winged Shadow Carry
Winged Shadow Carry.description: The user has the creature wrap around their torso, spread its arms and carry them through the air across a street or up several stories. One passenger may cling to the user during the flight. It cannot carry a crowd, and bright light shrinks its lifting surface, forcing a quick landing before the end of the user's next turn. Strain: heavy.
